subject: v2/development-network
summary: v2 reworks TORCH into a Development Network with three modes (Stewardship, Build, Foundry) sharing the existing funding, relay-locking, scheduling, and verification infrastructure, with custody minimization (compute principal routed directly to providers) as a co-equal design objective.

subject: v2/verified-seams
summary: v2 work builds on verified TORCH 1.x seams rather than assumptions: extend the kind-30078 lock payload (which already carries gitCommit/promptPath/promptHash provenance) instead of changing the event kind; keep the scheduler as sole completion authority; attach all runtime concerns (sandboxing, gateway routing, metering, credentials) at the single execution seam scripts/agent/run-selected-prompt.mjs. Where spec and code disagree, the bridge wins on facts and the spec on intent.

subject: v2/evolution-concept-subsumed
summary: The earlier TORCH_EVOLUTION_CONCEPT roster-to-DAG orchestration sketch is not a competing direction for v2; it survives as the orchestration layer inside v2 milestones while the Development Network spec answers funding and accountability.

subject: reports/location-standard
summary: Agent-generated reports must be written under reports/<category>/ and never to the repo root; root-level *.log/*.txt/*.json/*.md files are prohibited except standard docs.
